correctness.rationale: For every \(n\ge2\), prove the invertibility of (w_0,w_1, w_i XOR w_{i+2}) and explicitly show ordinary length-two duplication inserts two zeros in the derivative. Distinct outputs correspond exactly to gaps between derivative ones, so \(B=1+\sum_i[w_i\ne w_{i+2}]\). Enumerate all no-11 words through the finite-state matrix with suffix states 00,01,10 and weighted transitions [[1,u,0],[0,0,1],[u,1,0]], yielding the displayed rational formal series by exact matrix inversion. Its polynomial recurrence with the three base cases proves every coefficient for all lengths. A three-residue leading-degree induction proves the maximum and its multiplicities without extrapolation, and evaluating at \(u=0\) proves the three minimum-degree sources. Direct-channel exhaustive checks of 17,706 source words at lengths 2..18 and the independent polynomial recurrence through length 60 returned VERIFY_OK. No finite computation is treated as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The exact original contribution is the entire no-11 binary source polynomial A_n(u), its cubic rational length/degree generating series, the sharp maximum degree and the full mod-three multiplicities. Jain et al. and Lenz et al. already establish the two-step difference transformation and an unrestricted per-word sphere law; those are credited as premises, not novelty. The 2017 sphere lemma does not determine the distribution after imposing the 11-avoidance constraint, nor the restricted extremal multiplicity. Full RESULT.md texts of two closest indexed research records were read: one optimizes binary codebook cardinalities with unrestricted sources, and the other considers reverse-complement duplication. Neither implies the stated restricted forward-degree enumerator. The precise implication comparisons and gaps appear below. value.rationale: The no-consecutive-one language is the canonical binary finite-type/RLL source with F_{n+2} valid inputs and a standard constrained-channel role. Its complete forward-degree histogram is needed for finite-length tandem-duplication channel analysis and supplies more than the inherited pointwise derivative identity: a closed rational all-length spectrum, three uniquely characterized low-degree sources, and an exact worst-case degree only asymptotic to 2n/3 versus n-1 for unrestricted inputs. All three mod-three extremal multiplicities are determined. The object, local constraint, specific forward sphere statistic, and contrast to unrestricted source have independent coding motivation; no claim of optimal code capacity or downstream theorem is made.
